rows.en: Leave this to me!
I'll take you on!
I'll show you a battle beyond the speed of sound!
I'll show you the world of 0.01 seconds!
I'll teach you what a difference in skill looks like!
Heh... Now it's Liger's turn.
There's no escaping Getter Liger!
Emperor Burai, prepare yourself!
I'm sick of seeing your face, General Hidler!
Are you ready to die, Hyakki Empire?
Leave the demon-slaying to me!
Hyakki robot, I'll take you on!
Now it's our turn!
Here's some payback!!
Tch!! I must be losing my touch!!
What did you say!?
rows.notes: Also used by Emperor Burai; generic wording works for both.

rows.en: Tch!! I slipped up!
Damn! At this rate...
Kuh!! You're better than I thought.
Tch!! This is getting a little dicey!
Whoa! Did that do too much damage!?
Guh! I can't make a sorry show of myself here!
Tch... I never thought I'd get pushed this far.
I-I'm counting on you, Hayato!
rows.notes: Shared Getter Liger set: Ryoma or Benkei speaking to Hayato.
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Ryoma or Benkei (addresses Hayato).

rows.en: The next one's coming, stay sharp!
Wh-whoa! We took a hit, Hayato!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei or Ryoma (addresses Hayato).

rows.en: Gwah... That's a lot of damage!
Don't worry, I'll manage somehow!
Uagh! The enemy's zeroing in on us for sure!
Wh-what do we do now!?
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei (panicked partner line).

rows.en: Then I'll just finish them off with the next one!
Ugh! So they can keep up with Liger!
Hyakki Empire... Don't think I'll back down after this.
Whoa there!! Not yet!
Like I'd go down from this much!
Ugh!! You're pretty good!
Hmph! But I'm not beaten yet!
Not a chance! I'm not done yet!
Heh!! Not bad!!
Guh!! But I can still handle this much!!
W-we got hit!
Tch... Are we at a disadvantage like this!?
Then it's time to change, Hayato!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Ryoma or Benkei urging Hayato to change form.

rows.en: Tch, I got careless!
Don't do anything reckless, Hayato!
Yeah, Ryo's right!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei agreeing with Ryo.

rows.en: Th-they're latching onto us!?
Looks like this one's a tough opponent...!
What's wrong, you two... Losing your nerve isn't like you.
Heh... Landing a hit on my Getter? Not bad.
Liger taking a direct hit... I got careless.
Hoh... Not bad, Hyakki Empire!
Not good enough!
You're doing it all wrong.
Heh... Is that all?
Damn! I got hit!
Tch! It grazed me!
This damage is nothing!!
Heh... I'm still a softie, huh.
Hayato, that one grazed us!
uncertain: Partner line to Hayato; speaker inferred.

rows.en: So you can keep up with my speed!
I can't let my guard down against this one!
Whoa, you're pretty good!
Is their speed a match for ours!?
Hmph, stop joking around!
What's wrong, Hayato! This isn't like you.
Want me to take over for you?
Heh... You two couldn't handle that one.
rows.notes: Target of the line kept gender-neutral (that one).
uncertain: Hayato addressing Ryoma and Benkei after they suggest he struggles; referent inferred.

rows.en: I'll give you credit for hitting my Liger.
That's a disgrace to the Hyakki Empire name!
Too naive!
That won't hit me!
rows.notes: Also used by Vegan soldiers and Hugo Medio; generic wording.

rows.en: Don't underestimate Getter's speed!
Going after my Getter was your mistake.
Hayato!
Heh... Targeting my Getter is just reckless.
Sorry, I don't have time to play with you.
At that speed, you'll never hit me.
If it were me, that might've hit...
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei after Hayato's dodge.

rows.en: Don't feel bad. You just picked the wrong opponent.
uncertain: Read as Hayato taunting the attacker after a dodge; could alternatively be Hayato reassuring Benkei about the previous line.

rows.en: Can't be helped, going up against my Liger.
Heh... They're really looking down on us.
Hayato, it's too early to relax.
Impressive, Hayato.
Dodging something like that is a given.
That was close!
Nah, I dodged that with room to spare.
Heh... That doesn't hurt!
Beams are nothing!
Heh!
Defense system, activate!
rows.notes: Also used by Ryoma Nagare.

rows.en: This is a battle beyond the speed of sound!
I'll dodge it with an Open Get!
Mach Special!!
Damn! Are we too far away!?
Showing me an opening was the end of your luck!
One more strike with Getter's speed!
My Getter can still attack!
Heh... I'm such a soft touch.
Throwing the enemy into chaos is my specialty!
Fine, I'll help you out.
Liger Missile!!
Drill Arm!!
Raaaaah!! Daisetsuzan Oroshiiii!!
rows.notes: Benkei's attack; also used by Ryoma set.

rows.en: This is Michiru, commencing attack!
Here I go!
rows.notes: Also used by Ryoma Nagare; neutral wording.

rows.en: Just watch me!
This is Michiru, commencing counterattack!
Kyaaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Honorific -kun dropped per campaign rule; Ryo nickname per glossary.

rows.en: I've been taken down. Everyone, the rest is up to you!
Aaaaaah......!!
Kyaaaah! Father!
Oh no!! At this rate!
Ugh! It's no use, their power is too much!
Getter Queen can't hold its own!?
rows.notes: Glossary: Getter Q = Getter Queen.

rows.en: Like I'd go down from something like this!
Kuh! How dare you!
I'm okay! Getter Queen can still fight!
Ah!! Geez, I meant to dodge that!
Geez! You got me!
What, that was nothing!
This? It's just a scratch!
Don't underestimate Getter Queen!
I'm still fine with this much!
You've got to be kidding!
Knock it off!
Hah!!
rows.notes: Also used by Hikaru Makiba.

rows.en: Like that attack would hit me!
Hey, that was dangerous!
That attack won't work on me!
Beams won't work on me!
Out of energy!?
Oh no! I'm out of energy!
I can't reach it like this!
I can't counter with Getter Queen's weapons!
I can't counterattack......!?
I can't counterattack......
I won't let you escape!
Okay, let's do this!
Alright!
rows.notes: Also used by Ryoma Nagare.

rows.en: Getter Beam!
You can't escape this one!
uncertain: Ryoma's line inside Michiru's combo-attack set.

rows.en: Twin Tomahaaawk!!
rows.notes: Twin Tomahawk per glossary (marked unverified there).
uncertain: Twin Tomahawk glossary entry is an unverified literal rendering.

rows.en: Michiru!
rows.notes: Ryoma calling Michiru; honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Hyaah!
Michiru, believe in the power of Getter...!
rows.notes: Ryoma to Michiru; -san dropped.

rows.en: Double Getter Beeeam!!
uncertain: Double Getter Beam glossary entry is literal and unverified.

rows.en: I'll use any means necessary!
The time has come for us, the Hyakki clan, to conquer the world!
The whole world shall be miiine!
I'll finish you all in one go!
Defeat them at all costs and seize the Getter Ray amplifier!
Out of my waaay!
Silence!
Feel the might of us, the Hyakki clan!!
Curses... I won't forget this grudge even in death!
I, Burai, king of the Hyakki... Guoooooh!
You won't get off lightly either!
Don't give up!
uncertain: Read as Burai urging his own side (support/encouragement slot).

rows.en: Wh-what an outrage!
You dare make light of us, the Hyakki clan... You'll regret this!
Hmm, a tougher foe than I expected.
What are you dawdling for!
What a blunder!
Hm? What's going on!
Buhahahaha! No attack can so much as shake me!
Waahahahahaha! Victory is as good as mine!
There's no challenge in this at all.
Heh heh heh... Not bad, for an enemy.
I won't let the likes of you lay a finger on me!
Do you still not understand!
Well done!
Can't you see it's useless!
Blast it, what a disgrace!
What's the matter!?
Nonsense! Now is the perfect chance!
uncertain: Read as Burai scolding subordinates who hesitate; opening exclamation rendered as Nonsense.

rows.en: I'll scatter you all in one sweep!
You dare underestimate the power of the Hyakki clan!
Blast it, what are you doing!
Where are you aiming!? Wasn't it me you were after?
Blast it, fire, fire, keep on firiiing!
Die!!
This is the end for you!
Foolish humans! Take this!!
Reduce them to scrap!
Feel the power of the Empire!
The likes of you are no match for the great Hidler!
I will crush you without fail!
Bury them at any cost!
Show them the terror of the Hyakki!
Fool, you dare defy the Hyakki Empire!
I'll snuff the life out of you!
Mecha Yousaiki is invincible! Die!
Waaaaaaaaagh!!
Remember this!
I won't croak in a place like this!
Curses! This isn't over!
Impossible! To think they had this much power!
Not good! Should I fall back for now...
What are you dawdling around for!
Blast it! Don't think you've won with this much!
I'll make you pay for this with your own hands!
You'll regret ever wounding the great Hidler!
Oh! Not bad!
Fuhahahaha! Is that all!!
Coming at me with only that? You fool!
Just small fry after all!
Wh-what is this?
As if an attack like that would hit me!
Good, hold that altitude!
Hee hee hee hee hee hee, keep it up!
rows.notes: Hidler's distinctive giggle kept as Hee hee.

rows.en: Do you still not understand that it's useless!
What a fool!
I won't let you!
What a fool...
Curses! You got lucky!
I told you not to waste energy!
Tch! Lucky bastard!!
Damn, from that far away!?
Good, the time for an all-out attack has come!
Prepare for battle!
Now I'll finish them off myself!
Well done, fall back for now!
Hyaah!!
rows.notes: Also used by Kazuya Ryuzaki.

rows.en: I'll finish you in one blow!
Here's my trump card!
Believe in the power of Getter......!
Take the power of Getter!
Leave it to Getter!
Feel the power of the Dragoooon!
This is the end, Emperor Burai!
Prepare yourself, General Hidler!
Hyakki Empire, prepare yourselves!
Here I come, Hyakki robot!
You're up against us, Hyakki scum!
rows.notes: Plural derogatory suffix on Hyakki rendered as scum.

rows.en: How dare you!!
Now it's our turn!!
Kuh...!! Is this the end!!
Whoa!! Th-this is bad!!
Kuh! Not good......
Whoa!! What power!?
D-damn!! At this rate......
Gwah!! This is bad! At this rate!!
Whoa!! Did we take too much damage!?
Gah! I-I can't go down yet!!
Not yet! I'll show you what we're made of!
Gwah! Hayato, Benkei! Are you okay!?
I-I'm fine back here!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei (answers Ryoma's check).

rows.en: But there won't be a next time, Ryo!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Hayato.

rows.en: Ugh! What's wrong, Ryo!?
Come on, I'm begging you, get it together!
uncertain: Partner (Hayato or Benkei) urging Ryoma; speaker inferred.

rows.en: I know! I won't get hit next time!
Guh... To think they'd push us this far...!
You're not bad, for an enemy!
But I can't back down!
Th-this is bad! At this rate, even the Dragon...!
Gah! But we can't lose to the Hyakki Empire!!
Whoa!! I-I can still go!!
Ugh!! I won't let you!!
Whoa!! You're good!!
Not yet!! Not from something like this!!
Whoa! Why, you!!
Kuh! You're good! But I'm not done yet!!
Ngh!! I won't fall from this much!
Damn, did they hit the anti-gravity circuit!?
!! Getter! Not yet!!
H-hey, the enemy's moving fast!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei.

rows.en: Ryo! Let me take over!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Hayato.

rows.en: Damn, did we take a direct hit!?
What are you doing, Ryo!?
This isn't like you!
Looks like the enemy's a match for us.
R-really!?
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Benkei.

rows.en: If the three of us combine our strength, we can't lose!
Gwah!! Getter's got more than this!!
rows.notes: Rendered the trailing 'Getter is not done with just this' as a complete claim.

rows.en: You don't have the power to beat the Dragon!
Hyakki Empire... Don't get cocky!
Heh, this much is nothing!!
Hah, it only grazed us!
What's wrong, is that all you've got!
This much damage is nothing!
Hmph! Not yet!!
What, it hit!?
What's wrong, Ryo! Want me to take over!?
There's no need, Hayato!
Ryo, this is no time to be doing the enemy favors!
Dodge properly next time, will ya!
Yeah, I know!
Damn, did I fail to dodge!?
Were you looking the other way, Ryo!
Heh... I'm not you, you know.
uncertain: Ryoma retort to Hayato's teasing in previous row.

rows.en: That won't be enough to beat Getter!
As expected of Getter... This much is nothing!
That won't work on the Dragon!
Do you think you can beat us, Hyakki scum!
Whoops!
Too slow!
Too naive!
Hup!
rows.notes: Also used by Kazuya Ryuzaki.

rows.en: Ryo, I'm counting on you to keep that up!
Emergency evasion!
All right, that's Ryo for you!
Once I read your moves, it's nothing!
What's wrong, you're not stepping in far enough!
That won't even graze the Dragon!
Like that would ever hit our Getter!
Heh... Nice one, Ryo.
Yes! I deflected it completely!
Open Get! Emergency evasion!
Whoa! Damn! I can't counterattack!!
No good, not at this range!
Damn, not at this range!
I'll lend a hand with Getter Robo!
We'll follow up with an attack too!!
Not yet, one more hit! Take this!!
I'll keep it going! Koji!
Tetsuya! Leave the rest to me!
Michiru, I'll lend you a hand!
I'll take care of this enemy!
Leave this to me, and get away while you can!
I'll protect you with Getter Robo!
Koji, are you okay!?
Tetsuya, now's your chance!
Fall back, Michiru!
Here I go!!
Spin Cutteeer!!
rows.notes: Spin Cutter and Getter Shine names from campaign_terms glossary.

rows.en: Double Tomahaaaawk!!
Double Tomahaawk!
Double Tomahaawk Boooomerang!!
Double Tomahaawk! Boooomerang!!
Double Tomahawk Boomerang!
Getter Shiiiine!!
Shiiine Spaaaaark!!
You're not good enough to take on Getter!
rows.notes: Source uses the commonly misused idiom meaning the opponent is inadequate; translated by intended meaning.

rows.en: Don't underestimate the power of Getter...!
I'll send you to the depths of Hell!
Commence attack!
Out of my way!
Stop dawdling and attack now!
Plunge headfirst into the depths of Hell!
Have you come here to die!
Here I come, Duke Fleed!!
Duke Fleed! I will be the one to defeat you!
Duke Fleed! Today is your last day alive!
Here I come, Grendizer!!
No matter how much you run, it's all the same!
You'll regret defying us, the Vegan Empire!
What are you doing! Return fire, now!!
Impossible! This can't be happening!
J-Junioooor!!
rows.notes: Zuril crying out for his son Zuril Jr. (glossary).

rows.en: Kuh... Impossible!? I'm being beaten this badly!?
Guh, unforgivable! I will snuff you out for sure!
This can't be happening! Blast it!
C-curse youuuuu!
Kuh... This is nothing!
To do this much! I'll remember this!
Fufufu-fu, I'm not done yet!
So you came all this way just to throw your life away.
You intend to defy me?
So you came here of your own accord to die!
You call that an attack!
Naive! You challenge me, Zuril, with only that!?
This is easy.
Their power is just as I predicted.
Fufufu-fu, that won't work on me!
Fu fu fu fu fu, it seems you noticed a step too late.
Stop dawdling and resupply already!
Damn, where are you!?
What!? You've got to be kidding!
They're within our range! Provide support at once!
So you took our bait!
This mothership can take it! Use it to shield our units!
I'm your opponent! I can't let you have your way here!
In the name of the commander of the Vegan Empire!
Make a bloody example of them!
I'll finish you off!
Snuff out their lives!
Attack! Keep on attacking!
Shoot them down!
I'll show you what true terror is!
C-curse you! Curse you! Curse youuu!
Silence the enemy!
Smash them to pieces, whatever it takes!
Strike them down in return!
Damn, I've been hit!? Blast it, is this the end!
Gwaaaah!! My life, the life of Gandal, will soon be at an end......
Just a little more...... Just a little more and I'd have beaten them......
O-ohh!? Kuh, kuh... H-how strong!
Blast it, why can't I win!?
N-no, that's impossible!!
Prepare to evacuate! The escape saucer!
All hands, emergency evacuation, hurry! It's going to explode!
Guh, but I can't retreat like this!
Unthinkable!
What's wrong!? What happened!?
Failure will not be tolerated!
Too slow! What are you dawdling for!
What's going on!?
Unforgivable. I'll deliver judgment myself.
Surrender now while you still can.
So you've stuck your nose in again!
What is the matter!
rows.notes: Also used by King Vega.

rows.en: Fools, they've fallen right into our trap.
What is it, what's all this racket!
Fu fu fu fu, fools!
Naturally!
Impressive, that's quite some power!
The ignorant, incompetent lot are panicking!
Yes! Keep it up!
Well done!
The ignorant, incompetent Earthlings are panicking!
Curses! And we were so close.
Never mind! Look for a nearby enemy!
Your life is mine, I, Gandal, shall take it!
Fool! I am your opponent!!
